mapper.select: SELECT s.supplier_name, s.contact_name, p.product_name, p.product_code, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, c.customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, si.quantity, si.unit_price, sa.sale_date FROM supplier s JOIN product p ON s.id = p.supplier_id JOIN product_goods pg ON p.id = pg.product_id JOIN goods g ON pg.goods_id = g.id JOIN sale_item si ON g.id = si.goods_id JOIN sale sa ON si.sale_id = sa.id JOIN customer c ON sa.customer_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{supplierId} AND p.product_code = #{productCode} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT s.supplier_name, s.contact_name, p.product_name, p.product_code, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, c.customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, si.quantity, si.unit_price, sa.sale_date FROM customer c JOIN sale sa ON c.id = sa.customer_id JOIN sale_item si ON sa.id = si.sale_id JOIN goods g ON si.goods_id = g.id JOIN product_goods pg ON g.id = pg.goods_id JOIN product p ON pg.product_id = p.id JOIN supplier s ON p.supplier_id = s.id WHERE c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%') AND g.price >= #{minPrice} AND g.price <= #{maxPrice} ORDER BY c.id, g.price

SELECT s.supplier_name, s.contact_name, p.product_name, p.product_code, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, c.customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, si.quantity, si.unit_price, sa.sale_date FROM supplier s JOIN product p ON s.id = p.supplier_id JOIN product_goods pg ON p.id = pg.product_id JOIN goods g ON pg.goods_id = g.id JOIN sale_item si ON g.id = si.goods_id JOIN sale sa ON si.sale_id = sa.id JOIN customer c ON sa.customer_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{supplierId} AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%') AND sa.sale_date >= #{startDate} AND sa.sale_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY sa.sale_date DESC
